## Checklist

- [ ] `dotnet build -c Release` and `dotnet test -c Release` pass
- [ ] Still read-only (nothing writes to an adapter), or the change is discussed in an issue
- [ ] New protocol code has a unit test and an entry in `docs/PROTOCOL.md` (guesses marked as guesses)
- [ ] New UI text uses `L.T("English", "Hrvatski")`
- [ ] No real MAC addresses in code, tests, docs or screenshots
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated
